claims.assertion: Mari says death ends bodily processes, not ego, identity, or consciousness; the astral body reflects the deceased person's self-concept.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says low-astral groups exploit fearful living people and animals for energy and manifestation power.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She describes these groups as including entities that were never embodied.

claims.assertion: Mari says loving, recently deceased people may protect living relatives from negative astral entities.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She attributes this to the deceased person's higher vibration.
